warp_image_between_views: warp target images to the reference view using depth maps and camera extrinsics intrinsics
convert_pixels_to_3d_points: convert pixel coordinates and depth values to 3D points in camera space using intrinsics
reproject_points_between_cameras: reproject 3D points from a reference camera coordinate system to a target camera coordinate system
generate_warping_field: generate a warping field UV grid to sample one image frame into another using depth and camera params
project_camera_points_to_pixels: project 3D points in camera space back to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics
